sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.9041 of 2019
Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue for respondents and perused the material available on record.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this writ petition is filed questioning the action of the Respondents in interfering with the peaceful possession and enjoyment of the petitioner over the subject land admeasuring Ac.8-25 guntas in Sy.Nos.100/A/B/C/D situated at Mamunoor Village,
Khila Warangal Mandal, Warangal Urban District, without following due process of law.
3. The contention of the petitioner is that the petitioner has inherited the subject land since the father of the petitioner was recorded as pattedar as per the entries contained in Khasra Pahani for the year 1954-55.
Thereafter, the subject land has been mutated in the name of petitioner and pattadar passbooks and title deeds were also issued in favour of the petitioner.

While it being so, the respondents Nos.3 and 4 came to the land of petitioner with a JCB and tried to demolish the structures over the subject land without giving notice or opportunity to the petitioner.

Aggrieved by the action of the respondent authorities, the petitioner filed the present Writ Petition and requested to allow the same by directing the respondent authorities not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner without following due process of law.

4. On the other hand, basing on the counter filed by the respondent No.3, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue submits that mere mutation of name in the Revenue records does not create either extinguish title or does it have any presumptive value on the title and it is only enable the person in whose favour mutation is ordered to pay the land revenue to the exchequer.
The pattadar passbooks issued to the petitioner was irregular and without jurisdiction as the provisions of the Telangana Record of Rights and Pattdar Passbooks Act, 1971, (for brevity 'the ROR Act, 1971) is not applicable to the Government lands, as such, any such passbook even if issued, the same does not create any interest, right, title to agitate the same before this Court.

entities.text: Telangana Record of Rights and Pattdar Passbooks Act, 1971
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Therefore,
requested this Court to dismiss the writ petition as devoid of merits.

5. After hearing both sides and on perusing the entire material on record, this Court is of the considered view that admittedly there is no dispute with regard to the petitioner as pattadar of the subject land admeasuring Ac.8-25 guntas in Sy.Nos.100/A/B/C/D situated at Mamunoor Village,
Khila Warangal Mandal, Warangal Urban District.
The grievance of the petitioner is that the respondents without following due process of law interfering with the possession of the petitioner's property.

On the other hand, the respondent authorities have filed counter as well as additional counter stating that they are not disputing with the possession of the petitioner and the issuance of pattadar passbooks and title deeds in favour of the petitioner, but, the same were irregular and Ganta Buchiram Reddy vs The State Of Telangana on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184328246/
1 contrary to the ROR Act, 1971.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per records, it clearly shows that the respondent authorities without following any procedure interfere with the possession of the subject property on the ground that the passbooks and title deeds are irregular.
If the respondent authorities feels that pattadar passbooks and title deeds are irregular, they have to take appropriate steps to cancel the same in appropriate proceedings.
Without initiating any proceedings, the respondent authorities not to interfere with the possession of the subject property.

7. In view of the above finding, this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondent authorities not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner's land admeasuring Ac.8-25 guntas in Sy.Nos.100/A/B/C/D situated at Mamunoor Village, Khila Warangal Mandal, Warangal Urban District.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they are directed to follow the procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: No order as to costs.
8. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition, shall stand closed.
